description: Mail servers (MX) of a domain, sorted, with the mail provider. MX records sorted by priority, null-MX detection (RFC 7505), the implicit-MX fallback (A/AAAA) when no MX exists, and the detected mail provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho, Proton, ...). Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
